# SilverSea 0.1.10

This update fixes the black window that could appear when starting SilverSea on some Windows PCs. It also includes the SilverSea app icon and automatic update support.

## Install or update

Download **SilverSea-Setup.exe** below and run it. Your library and settings are kept when you install a newer version.
